property_summary: After calling transferOwnership with a non-zero newOwner, the owner() must equal newOwner; the buggy version violates this because transferring to zero silently sets the owner to zero, whereas the correct version reverts, so a subsequent transfer to any non-zero address succeeds in the buggy version but the reference still has the previous non-zero owner.
change_summary: Remove the require check that prevents transferring ownership to the zero address.
